answer: Streak multipliers at the beacon: identity i's weight w_i = base × (1+r)^s_i, capped at s=90 epochs. Each sybil must independently sustain the echo of daily attestations; missing one resets s_i to 0. Splitting into n identities multiplies cost n while honest throughput stays flat, so a farm drowning in an ocean of fresh keys needs n×90 valid proofs before matching one veteran's weight. At $0.02/proof, 100 sybils cost $180 vs $1.80 for one. Conclusion: linear-weight rewards against exponential-cost streaks make sybil farming strictly unprofitable.
